document.abstract: This article expands upon the keynote address presented by Roland J. Zavada at the 133rd SMPTE Technical Conference in Los Angeles, CA, on October 26, 1991. It first appeared in the Journal in March 1992 and is presented here to provide some historical insight into SMPTE as we begin the year 2000. Part II will appear in the February Journal.
